name: The Alliance Needs Your Help!
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Requires level 1 instead of 49. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Hello, I'm glad that you've decided to hear me out. The Alliance needs all of the help that it can get to prepare for the Ahn'Qiraj War, and that means that we need you! Even now as we speak, official collectors are gathering the necessary material needed for the upcoming war, but we won't be able to meet our goals without your assistance, adventurer!

You should go speak with the guy in charge, Field Marshal Snowfall. What do you say, champion? Will you help out with the vital preparations?
narrative.objectives: Speak with Field Marshal Snowfall in Ironforge's Military Ward.
